stops.caption: Far out at sea, the sun sparkles on the water. But what is down below?
Splash! Down we go, to the coral reef. Somebody is waving.

hotspots.caption: “Psst! I’m Finn. Something is glowing far down in the dark. Will you go and see what it is? Ask Old Turtle the way.”
hotspots.name: Finn the clownfish

hotspots.caption: Old Turtle blinks slowly. “A glow in the deep? Swim down through the kelp forest and ask the seahorses.”
hotspots.name: Old Turtle

hotspots.caption: “We saw it!” squeak the seahorses. “The glow is down past the sunken ship. Octopus lives there.”
hotspots.name: the seahorses

hotspots.caption: Octopus points with four arms at once. “Down there, where it gets dark! Listen for the whale’s song.”
hotspots.name: Octopus

hotspots.caption: The whale sings, low and slow. “Keep going, little diver. You are nearly at the bottom.”
hotspots.name: the whale

hotspots.caption: You found it! It is Angler’s lantern. “I keep it shining,” she says, “so that nobody down here ever feels lost.”
hotspots.name: the glowing light

hotspots.caption: A tiny island with one palm tree. Even the sea has a beach.
hotspots.name: the island

hotspots.caption: A little sailboat, way up on top of the water.
hotspots.name: the sailboat

hotspots.caption: Whee! A dolphin jumps for joy.
hotspots.name: the dolphin

hotspots.caption: A whole school of fish, all turning together.
hotspots.name: the school of fish

hotspots.caption: Puff! The pufferfish is as round as a ball.
hotspots.name: the pufferfish

hotspots.caption: Jellyfish drift along like little umbrellas.
hotspots.name: the jellyfish

hotspots.caption: Click, clack. Crab waves his claws hello.
hotspots.name: the crab

hotspots.caption: A starfish, taking it easy on the sand.
hotspots.name: the starfish

hotspots.caption: A giant clam, keeping its pearl safe.
hotspots.name: the giant clam

hotspots.caption: A secret cave, sparkling with crystals!
hotspots.name: the crystal cave

hotspots.caption: A manta ray glides by like a kite.
hotspots.name: the manta ray

hotspots.caption: A shark! Don’t worry, this one only smiles.
hotspots.name: the shark

hotspots.caption: Treasure! A chest full of shiny gold coins.
hotspots.name: the treasure chest

hotspots.caption: Some jellyfish make their own light.
hotspots.name: the glowing jellyfish

hotspots.caption: Peekaboo! An eel hides in the rocks.
hotspots.name: the eel

hotspots.caption: A little submarine has come exploring too.
hotspots.name: the submarine

hotspots.caption: A lost anchor from the old ship.
hotspots.name: the anchor

hotspots.caption: A message in a bottle. Who sent it, do you think?
hotspots.name: the bottle

hotspots.caption: A fossil! This sea creature swam here millions of years ago.
hotspots.name: the big fossil

hotspots.caption: Warm water bubbles up here from deep inside the Earth. Tube worms love it.
hotspots.name: the warm vents
